clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshire, a bottle of moonshine is sought for Lakeshire’s tavern. Barkeep Daniels needs one while Blackrock orc incursions keep regular supplies from reaching town.

Blackrock orcs have cut off Lakeshire’s regular supply caravans. Barkeep Daniels seeks regional drinks to restock the tavern for the guards and townsfolk. One is brewed and sold at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire, where locals favor strong drinks.
